Name: Owlbear horse replacer
Author: spacesheepcaptain
Description:
[size=3][font=Times New Roman][color=#cccccc][center]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1853][img]https://i.imgur.com/h1g09yn.png[/img][/url]﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2068][img]https://i.imgur.com/USOlcoV.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4258][img]https://i.imgur.com/CAi81sa.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25142][img]https://i.imgur.com/o5eKPQe.png[/img][/url]
★★★[/center][/color][/font][/size]hello!

tbh, this was a personal mod for a LONG while, since i wasn't sure it was good enough to share and later i just stopped playing sdw at all, forgetting about it completely... but BG3 happened and it reminded me about this old project of mine :) so i decided, why should this mod continue to collect dust, so to speak, if i can share it with people who still play sdw, right? so i fixed a few old mistakes on sprites, freshened them up a bit (because they looked less detailed before) and voila!!!

enjoy :D

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6semRXO.gif[/img]
[font=Verdana][color=#b4a7d6][b]installation (CP):[/b][/color][/font][b] [/b][color=#f4f4f4]first of all, make sure you have installed [/color][color=#f4f4f4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and everything it requires! drop my folder with owlbears into your [b]"***[/b][/color][b]\Stardew Valley\[/b][b]Mods"[/b][color=#f4f4f4]. you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] ingame to choose the rest (color, saddle etc.). [/color][color=#999999][b]or[/b] after this you need to run your game ONCE to create the [b]config.json[/b] file (which can be opened by [b]notepad[/b]). this way, you can specify which one of the owlbears do you want and which saddle or even if you want one at all:
  "Horse": "owlbear-dark", (or "owlbear-brown", or "owlbear-white")
  "HasSaddle": "true", (or "false", if you don't need it at all)
  "SaddleColor": "red", (or "orange", or "purple", or "armor")[/color]
[b][font=Verdana][color=#b4a7d6]installation (AT): [/color][/font][/b]same as the above (drop the files into "Mods"), but you need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] instead of CP. the rest is explained on AT main page.

also don't forget that you can edit/recolor any [b].png[/b] to your own liking by using [b]paint.net [/b]or any simular program!

[right]anyway... if something is wrong let me know and i'll try to fix it![/right][right][img]https://i.imgur.com/6semRXO.gif[/img][/right][size=1][b][i][u][right][/right][/u][/i][/b][/size][url=https://www.deviantart.com/gasara/art/Animated-Rainbow-Heart-Divider-331662041][size=1][b][i][u][right]border[/right][/u][/i][/b][/size][/url]
